chapters.title: The Perceptron
chapters.blurb: A line that learns from its own mistakes — the real perceptron update rule, replayed nudge by nudge until eight corrections separate the clusters.

chapters.title: Activation Functions
chapters.blurb: Two stacked linear layers collapse to a single line — but give each unit one hinge and a real sixteen-unit network bends itself onto a wavy target.

chapters.title: The Loss Landscape
chapters.blurb: Two knobs, one rippled surface: why every training run is a walk among valleys, saddles, and basins — and why where you start decides where you land.

chapters.title: Overfitting
chapters.blurb: Real polynomial fits crank from too stiff to threading every point — and the held-out test set draws the U-curve that separates memorizing from learning.

chapters.title: Regularization
chapters.blurb: Ridge penalties shrink a wild polynomial's weights into a smooth fit, a U-curve pins the sweet spot, and a dropout-style ensemble buys generalization.
